shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md package.json app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

# Remove only artifacts and configuration rewrites produced by this verification build.
Path('tsconfig.json').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tsconfig.json']))
Path('next-env.d.ts').unlink()
shutil.rmtree('.next')
PY

git diff --check && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { writeFileSync, unlinkSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'

// Remove only artifacts and configuration rewrites produced by this verification build.
writeFileSync('tsconfig.json', execFileSync('git', ['show', 'HEAD:tsconfig.json']))
unlinkSync('next-env.d.ts')
rmSync('.next', { recursive: true })
NODE

git diff --check && git status --short"
